Here is a complete, budget-optimized **4-Day Singapore Itinerary for 2 People**, crafted to stay strictly within the budget of **₹80,000**. --- ### **Trip Summary** * **Destination:** Singapore * **Duration:** 4 Days / 3 Nights * **Travelers:** 2 Adults * **Total Estimated Budget:** **₹79,500** (Under the ₹80,000 limit) --- ### **Accommodation & Transportation Overview** * **Accommodation:** 3 Nights stay at a well-reviewed budget hotel/boutique stay (e.g., *ibis budget Singapore Sapphire*, *Venue Hotel The Lily*, or *Spacepod@SG*). * **Local Transportation:** **Singapore Tourist Pass / EZ-Link Card** for unlimited or pay-as-you-go travel on the MRT (subway) and public buses, plus airport transfers via MRT. --- ### **Detailed Day-by-Day Itinerary** #### **Day 1: Iconic Marina Bay & Gardens by the Bay** * **Morning / Afternoon:** * **Activity 1: Merlion Park & Marina Bay Waterfront Promenade** * Take iconic photos with the Merlion statue overlooking Marina Bay Sands, walk along the waterfront promenade, and cross the Helix Bridge. * **Late Afternoon / Evening:** * **Activity 2: Gardens by the Bay (Conservatories & Supertree Light Show)** * Visit the **Cloud Forest** and **Flower Dome** conservatories. * In the evening, watch the free **Garden Rhapsody** light and sound show under the majestic Supertrees (7:45 PM or 8:45 PM). * **Dining Suggestion:** Lunch at *Satay by the Bay*; Dinner at *Lau Pa Sat Hawker Center* (try the famous satay street). --- #### **Day 2: Cultural Enclaves & Sentosa Island** * **Morning:** * **Activity 1: Heritage Tour – Chinatown & Kampong Glam** * Visit Chinatown (Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Sri Mariamman Temple). * Head to Kampong Glam to see the stunning Sultan Mosque and explore vibrant Haji Lane for street art and boutique shops. * **Afternoon / Evening:** * **Activity 2: Sentosa Island Excursion** * Take the Sentosa Express monorail from VivoCity to Sentosa. * Relax at **Siloso Beach / Palawan Beach** and watch the evening **Wings of Time** night show or visit the **S.E.A. Aquarium**. * **Dining Suggestion:** Lunch at *Chinatown Complex Food Centre* (affordable Michelin-recommended stalls); Dinner at *VivoCity Food Republic*. --- #### **Day 3: Nature, Heritage & Shopping** * **Morning:** * **Activity 1: Singapore Botanic Gardens & National Orchid Garden** * Explore Singapore’s UNESCO World Heritage site. Stroll through the lush greenery and visit the vibrant **National Orchid Garden**. * **Afternoon / Evening:** * **Activity 2: Little India & Orchard Road Exploration** * Visit Little India (Sri Veeramakaliamman Temple and 24-hour *Mustafa Centre* for souvenirs/treats). * Walk down iconic **Orchard Road** for window shopping and city vibes. * **Dining Suggestion:** Lunch at *Tekka Centre* in Little India; Dinner at *Far East Plaza Food Court* or an Orchard Road hawker stall. --- #### **Day 4: History & Jewel Changi Experience** * **Morning:** * **Activity 1: Fort Canning Park & Tree Tunnel / National Museum** * Walk through Fort Canning Park, take photos at the famous spiral staircase (Tree Tunnel), or visit the National Museum of Singapore. * **Afternoon:** * **Activity 2: Jewel Changi Airport Marvels** * Head to Changi Airport early to explore **Jewel Changi**. See the world's tallest indoor waterfall (**HSBC Rain Vortex**) and walk around the **Canopy Park**. * **Departure:** Evening flight back home. --- ### **Estimated Budget Cost Breakdown (For 2 People)** | Expense Category | Details | Estimated Cost (INR) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Flights** | Round-trip budget flights for 2 (e.g., AirAsia / Scoot from South India/Kochi/Chennai) | ₹34,000 | | **Accommodation** | 3 Nights in a double room (Budget Hotel / Private Room in Boutique Hostel) | ₹16,500 | | **Local Transport** | MRT & Bus Tourist Passes / EZ-Link cards for 4 days (2 pax) | ₹4,500 | | **Attractions & Activities** | • Gardens by the Bay Conservatories: ~₹4,200
• Wings of Time / S.E.A. Aquarium: ~₹4,500
• National Orchid Garden: ~₹600
• Jewel Canopy Park & Museum entries: ~₹2,200 | ₹11,500 | | **Food & Meals** | Meals at Hawker Centers & casual eateries (~₹2,250/day for 2 pax) | ₹9,000 | | **Miscellaneous / Buffer** | SIM card, snacks, emergency buffer | ₹4,000 | | **TOTAL ESTIMATED COST** | **For 2 People** | **₹79,500** | --- ### **Money-Saving Tips Included in Plan:** 1. **Public Transit:** The MRT system is fast, efficient, and cheap—avoid expensive taxis/tours. 2. **Food:** Singapore’s UNESCO-listed Hawker Centers offer world-class meals for ₹300–₹500 (5–8 SGD) per person. 3. **Free Attractions:** Merlion Park, Supertree Light Show, Botanic Gardens, Haji Lane, and Jewel Rain Vortex cost zero entry fees.
